usdc.description: USDC amount as a decimal string, up to 6 decimals.

amount.description: Token amount as a decimal string.

request_id.description: Any new id per request; repeat it to retry safely.

confirm.description: One-time code from the card; never shown to the model.

confirm_meta.description: Result _meta "yeet/confirm": read by the card only.

parts.description: Whole parts, 0-99. A coin's share is its parts divided by the basket's total parts (6 and 4 = 60% and 40%; 3, 1 and 1 = 60%, 20% and 20%). 0 leaves the coin out; at least one coin needs 1 or more.

amount_in.description: What this leg spends: USDC for yeet, the coin for skeet.

enum: ⚡ YEET is ready in the card.
⚡ SKEET is ready in the card.

min_leg_usdc.description: Minimum USDC each coin in a YEET basket must get (the card warns before a coin goes under it).

lands_on.description: The network the result lands on: coins on Solana for a YEET; for a SKEET the network the USDC is paid out on.

message.description: With BALANCE_LOW on a trade it names the person’s USDC on Base and on Solana.

fund_url.description: With BALANCE_LOW: where the person adds USDC. The card shows an Add funds button that opens it.

terms.description: With TERMS_REQUIRED: the current terms and where the person accepts them.

missing.description: With TERMS_REQUIRED from yeet_accept_terms: required statements that were not confirmed.

app_refresh.description: With APP_OUTDATED: where the person refreshes YEET in ChatGPT and how.

attempt_id.description: One sign attempt of one or more legs of a trade.

send_status.description: awaiting_signature: the person has not signed yet; signing: signed and on its way; awaiting_gas: signed, network fee on its way; sent: on chain; failed and not_sent: nothing moved.

solana_tx_payload.description: A Solana transaction for the person to sign as its second signer. YEET pays the network fee as the first signer.

evm_tx_payload.description: An EIP-1559 transaction for the person to sign (sign only, never send). Integers above 2^53 are decimal strings.

domain.description: The Calibur EIP-712 domain of the person's own wallet (verifyingContract is the wallet).

calls.description: One USDC transfer per leg, in leg order.

executor.description: YEET's gas wallet: the only sender that can run this batch.

deadline.description: Unix seconds; the batch cannot run after it.

typed_data.description: Passed to the wallet's eth_signTypedData_v4 unchanged.

authorization.description: Set only while the wallet is not yet delegated to Calibur: the one-time EIP-7702 authorization to sign.

evm_7702_payload.description: A Base basket as one Calibur batch (EIP-7702): the person signs the batch, plus the authorization when one is set. YEET's gas wallet sends it and pays the fee.

message.description: The exact text the wallet approves: one token_diff of what the person gives and the least they receive.

message_base64.description: base64 of the UTF-8 bytes of message: the bytes the wallet approves, unchanged.

signer_id.description: The ledger account of the wallet: the 32 bytes of its address, in hex.

near_intent_payload.description: A ledger trade: one message for the NEAR Intents ledger that the person approves with their Solana key. No transaction: the wallet sends nothing and there is no network fee.

legs.description: Every leg this one transaction pays (Solana transaction or Base 7702 batch); legs[0] is leg.

sign_request.description: What the person's own wallet signs for one or more legs of a trade (one signature). Sign it with the wallet named in `wallet`, sign only, never broadcast.

limits.description: BUY caps of the person's XP tier, per trade and per UTC day. Sells are never capped.

spin_reason.description: Why an extra spin was granted.

wheel_slice.description: One wheel slice: a tradable coin and the bonus XP value shown on it (base_xp is paid on top).

lucky_id.description: Id of one lucky wheel (one per account and UTC day).

lucky.description: The lucky wheel: the coins the server picked at random for today, not by popularity; YEET amount_usdc into the landed coin for one bonus daily spin and a stamp of that coin.

slice.description: Index into wheel where the spin landed; null before the spin.

claimed.description: True once a settled YEET of at least amount_usdc into the landed coin granted the bonus spin.

stamp_count.description: Stamps of one coin: the card being filled now is floor(count/7)+1 with progress count % 7.

guidance.description: Text for the assistant about this result; the card does not read it.

network.description: A network one of the person’s two YEET wallets is on.

funding.description: The person’s USDC on each network and the network that pays a YEET. USDC on Base or on Solana can pay; one network pays the whole basket (never split). A null balance could not be read just now.

chosen.description: The network whose USDC pays: the one that covers the amount, the larger balance when both do. null when neither covers it.

xp_summary.description: XP, streak, stamps and the daily wheel of one person.

next_streak_milestone.description: The next streak length that pays a streak bonus and its fixed XP (the bonus draw comes on top); null when none is left.

wheel.description: The slices the next daily_spin returns today, before the spin (the landing slice is not marked).

signed_usd.description: US dollars as a decimal string, negative for a loss.

card_build.description: Set by the card only: the build of the card that makes this call.

text.description: What the person agrees to, in one sentence.

url.description: The document or section this statement refers to.

required.description: false: the person may leave it out (product emails).

terms.description: The YEET terms the person accepts once per version, and where they stand.

accepted.description: true: the person accepted this version.

version.description: The current version. A new version is asked again.

mode.description: chat: the assistant shows the statements and records the acceptance with yeet_accept_terms. page: the person accepts on page_url.

page_url.description: The YEET page with the same statements as checkboxes. It records the same acceptance.

referral.description: The win code: asked once, after the terms and before the first trade.

code.description: The code that was applied, else null.

username.description: The name the person goes by on YEET.

usdc.description: All the USDC the person can YEET with, as one number. null: it could not be read just now.

checkin_open.description: true while today’s daily check-in (the wheel) still has a spin left.

holdings_count.description: How many different meme coins the person holds.

top_winner.description: The held coin that is up the most against the person’s own average YEET price, or null.

say.description: What the person would say to pick it.

app_refresh.description: Present when the person’s YEET app in ChatGPT is out of date: where they refresh it and how.

referral_open.description: true: the win code was never asked.

change_pct.description: Price change in percent over the last 1 hour, 6 hours and 24 hours (1.5 is +1.5%). A window the price source does not have is null.

deposit_watch.description: How far a deposit to the person’s YEET deposit address is, when the server follows it. steps: the stages this account’s card shows, in order (only stages the server can really observe are listed). stage: where it is now; detected: the USDC was seen arriving at the deposit address on its network and is not in the account yet (detected_usdc and detected_tx when known); other_coin: a coin that is not USDC arrived, named in coin. arrived_usdc: the USDC that arrived, once stage is ready. No address is ever in here.

detected_usdc.description: The USDC seen arriving at the deposit address, when stage is detected and the amount is known.

detected_tx.description: The network transaction that brought it, when known. A transaction id, never an address.

coin.description: The coin that arrived when stage is other_coin, as its symbol.

deposit.description: Card only (result _meta, never structuredContent or content): the connected account’s own YEET deposit addresses, one per network it can be funded on today. default is the network a first YEET spends from; the Add funds card opens on it. The model never reads an address.

how_it_works_section.description: One part of how YEET handles the wallet and the keys.

url.description: The page this part refers to, when there is one.

how_it_works.description: Security, wallet and private-key facts: who holds the keys, what the YEET server can and cannot do, and how the person exports their key.

provider.description: The wallet is a Privy embedded wallet.

custody.description: YEET never holds the person's keys or funds.

export_url.description: Where the person exports their private key, signed in with the same login as YEET.

yeet_overview.title: YEET overview
yeet_overview.description: Shows the welcome card with the person's USDC, XP, tier, streak, daily check-in state and next actions.

app_version.description: The tools version this tool list was built for.

yeet_terms.title: YEET terms
yeet_terms.description: Returns the current YEET terms statements with their links and whether the person accepted this version.

yeet_accept_terms.title: Accept the YEET terms
yeet_accept_terms.description: Records the person's acceptance of the current YEET terms version.

version.description: terms.version as shown to the person.

confirmed.description: Ids of the statements the person confirmed.

overview.description: The overview, so the conversation continues. null: it could not be read just now.

yeet_how_it_works.title: How YEET works
yeet_how_it_works.description: Returns the security and wallet facts: who holds the keys, what YEET's server can and cannot do, and how the person exports their private key.

yeet_referral.title: Win code
yeet_referral.description: Shows the win code card: one input that starts with WIN, Apply and Skip.

apply_referral.title: Apply win code
apply_referral.description: Card only: apply the win code the person typed, or record that they skipped it.

code.description: The code to apply. Leave out with skip.

skip.description: true: the person skipped the code.

yeet_home.title: YEET home
yeet_home.description: Shows whether the person's YEET account is ready to trade, their USDC and their XP.

usdc.description: All the USDC the person can YEET with, as one number. null: it could not be read just now.

fund_url.description: The YEET funding page. The card opens it from its Add funds button while ready is needs_funds.

yeet_coins.title: YEET coins
yeet_coins.description: Lists every tradable coin with its USD price, its percent change over 1, 6 and 24 hours, and the trade limits.

as_of.description: When the prices were read; null when no price could be read just now.

yeet_coin.title: YEET coin
yeet_coin.description: Shows the coin card for one coin: its USD price, its change over 1, 6 and 24 hours, the person's holding and the basket limits.

symbol.description: The coin's symbol as yeet_coins lists it, for example WIF.

as_of.description: When the price was read; null when no price could be read just now.

market_cap_usd.description: Market value in USD, or null.

volume_24h_usd.description: USD traded in the last 24 hours, or null.

liquidity_usd.description: USD in the coin's trading pools, or null.

description.description: Third-party text about the coin from its listing on a market data site: the coin's own project's claims, not YEET's.

website.description: The coin's own website as a market data site lists it (third-party), or null; the card does not show it.

x.description: The coin's profile on X as a market data site lists it (third-party), or null; the card does not show it.

holding.description: What the person holds of this coin; null when they hold none or it could not be read just now.

say.description: What the person would say to pick it.

yeet/chart.description: Card only: the coin's price over the last 24 hours, oldest first, about one point an hour. Left out when no history could be read.

yeet_propose.title: Quote a YEET basket
yeet_propose.description: Quotes a YEET (buy) basket that spends USDC on 1-5 coins split by whole-number parts and shows the basket card; it buys nothing.

lucky_id.description: Optional: the lucky wheel this YEET is for. Set it when proposing the coin the lucky wheel landed on.

yeet_quote.title: Refresh a YEET quote
yeet_quote.description: Refreshes an existing YEET or SKEET quote by proposal_id and saves it as a new revision; it trades nothing.

execute_trade.title: Run a confirmed trade
execute_trade.description: Starts a quoted basket from the card. Only the card can call this; it needs the one-time code the card holds. Answers one transfer request per coin, which the person’s own wallet approves in the card.

funded_from.description: The network of the wallet that pays this trade: USDC on that network for a YEET, the coins on Solana for a SKEET.

lands_on.description: The network the result lands on: coins on Solana for a YEET; for a SKEET the network the USDC is paid out on.

submit_trade_signature.title: Send a trade transfer
submit_trade_signature.description: Takes the transfer the person’s own wallet approved for one coin of a trade. Only the card calls this, once per request; YEET checks it, adds the network fee and sends it.

signed.description: base64 (Solana), 0x02 hex (Base evm_tx), 0x + 65-byte batch signature [+ 65-byte authorization signature] (Base evm_7702), base64 of the 64-byte signature (near_intent), or `unsupported`.

funded_from.description: The network of the wallet that pays this trade: USDC on that network for a YEET, the coins on Solana for a SKEET.

lands_on.description: The network the result lands on: coins on Solana for a YEET; for a SKEET the network the USDC is paid out on.

trade_status.title: Trade status
trade_status.description: Returns the live status of a trade and what was received.

funded_from.description: The network of the wallet that pays this trade: USDC on that network for a YEET, the coins on Solana for a SKEET.

lands_on.description: The network the result lands on: coins on Solana for a YEET; for a SKEET the network the USDC is paid out on.

yeet_portfolio.title: YEET portfolio
yeet_portfolio.description: Shows the coins and USDC the person holds on YEET, with values.

yeet_fund.title: Fund your YEET account
yeet_fund.description: Shows the Add funds card, on the crypto or card view when method is given, otherwise with both choices.

method.description: How the person wants to add money: crypto (send USDC to their YEET deposit address) or card (pay by card on the YEET page). Leave it out when they have not chosen: the card then shows both choices.

usdc.description: All the USDC the person can YEET with, as one number. null: it could not be read just now.

presets.description: Amounts the card payment offers, in USDC.

method.description: The view the card opens on: the method the tool was called with. Left out: the card shows both choices.

fund_url.description: The YEET funding page, for a card payment. The card opens it; with ?amount= it starts on that preset.

methods.description: The ways this account can add money right now. Left out: both. One entry: the card shows that one alone. Empty: adding funds is not available for this account yet, and the card says so.

min_deposit_usdc.description: The least USDC to send in one deposit, when the account has one. The card says “Send at least N USDC on <network> to this address.” A smaller deposit is still credited.

skeet_propose.title: Quote a SKEET
skeet_propose.description: Quotes a SKEET (sell) of a percent of 1-5 held coins back to USDC and shows the SKEET card; it sells nothing.

yeet_leaderboard.title: YEET leaderboard
yeet_leaderboard.description: Shows a YEET leaderboard (xp, winners, best_trade, losers or coins) for a time window, with the person's place.

board.description: Default xp. week is xp over 7d.

window.description: today is the current UTC day. Default: all for xp, today for the others.

people.description: coins board: how many people yeeted this coin.

unit.description: Which row field ranks this board.

measure.description: How this board is measured, in one sentence. The card prints it under the rows.

yeet_checkin.title: Daily check-in
yeet_checkin.description: Shows the daily check-in card: the wheel, the streak and the stamps.

daily_spin.title: Daily XP spin
daily_spin.description: Card only: uses the next available daily or bonus spin and awards its XP and stamp.

wheel.description: One slice per coin, catalog order; every slice shows a different value.

slice.description: Index into wheel where the spin lands; wheel[slice].xp equals draw_xp.

set_bonus_xp.description: XP paid for completing a set with this stamp; not part of xp_won, included in total.

spins_available.description: Spins left today after this one.

yeet_profile.title: YEET profile
yeet_profile.description: Returns the person's YEET display name, XP, tier and streak.

yeet_set_username.title: Set YEET username
yeet_set_username.description: Replaces the person's YEET display name.

lucky_wheel.title: Lucky wheel
lucky_wheel.description: Shows today's lucky wheel card: up to five randomly picked coins and the YEET offer for the coin it lands on.

lucky_spin.title: Spin the lucky wheel
lucky_spin.description: Pick the lucky wheel’s coin. Only the card calls this; one draw per wheel, and a repeat returns the same coin.

overview.title: Welcome
overview.description: The welcome card: “Welcome back,” and the person’s name, large, with their USDC, XP and streak. The same for every account.

home.title: YEET home
home.description: Account readiness, USDC balance, XP, streak and the daily spin.

basket.title: YEET basket
basket.description: A quoted basket: coins with their parts, each coin's share in percent and USDC, an amount slider, estimated amounts, cost, and the YEET or SKEET button.

receipt.title: YEET receipt
receipt.description: Live status of a trade per coin, amounts received, explorer links and a share picture once it is done.

portfolio.title: YEET portfolio
portfolio.description: Coins and USDC in the YEET wallets, each coin with a YEET more button and a SKEET button, and a share picture.

leaderboard.title: YEET leaderboard
leaderboard.description: XP ranks and your place on the board.

wheel.title: Daily check-in
wheel.description: The daily check-in: one wheel spin a day for XP and a coin stamp, the streak and the stamp cards.

lucky.title: Lucky wheel
lucky.description: A trading offer: five coins picked at random, the wheel picks one, and a YEET of the offered amount into it.

fund.title: Add funds
fund.description: Add funds: two choices. Send USDC shows the person’s YEET deposit address in full with a Copy button, a QR code and the one network to send on; Pay by card has amount presets and the button that opens the YEET funding page. The card reports back when USDC arrives.

referral.title: Win code
referral.description: One input for a win code, starting with WIN, with Apply and Skip.

coin.title: YEET coin
coin.description: One coin: its logo, ticker and name, the price, a small chart of the last 24 hours, the change over 1 hour, 6 hours and 24 hours, what the person holds of it, and one YEET button that asks the chat for a basket of it.

x-yeet-app.refresh_steps: open YEET there, select Refresh, then start a new chat

x-yeet-spin.parts: xp_won = base_xp + draw_xp + streak_xp; draw_xp is one bonus_xp value; streak_xp is 0, or on a streak milestone streak_bonus_xp plus a second, independent bonus_xp draw

x-yeet-scopes.yeet:read: See your YEET balance, coins, trades and XP.
x-yeet-scopes.yeet:write: Get quotes, spin the daily wheel and record what you confirm in the chat.
x-yeet-scopes.yeet:prepare: Prepare trades for you to confirm yourself.

INVALID_ARGUMENT.title: Check the request
INVALID_ARGUMENT.message: A value in the request is not valid, so check the coins, parts and amount.

COIN_NOT_SUPPORTED.title: Coin not available
COIN_NOT_SUPPORTED.message: One of these coins can’t be traded on YEET right now, so pick another from the coin list.

PARTS_EMPTY.title: Pick at least one coin
PARTS_EMPTY.message: Every coin is at 0 parts, so give at least one coin 1 or more parts.

AMOUNT_TOO_SMALL.title: A coin gets too little
AMOUNT_TOO_SMALL.message: Each coin needs at least the minimum per coin (3 USDC), so raise the amount, give the smallest coin more parts or set it to 0.

COST_TOO_HIGH.title: Fees too high right now
COST_TOO_HIGH.message: Swap costs for this basket are above the YEET limit, so try a larger amount or fewer coins.

LIMIT_EXCEEDED.title: Over your limit
LIMIT_EXCEEDED.message: This trade would go over the per-trade or daily USDC limit.

BALANCE_LOW.title: Not enough funds
BALANCE_LOW.message: Your YEET wallet doesn’t hold enough for this trade, so add funds or lower the amount.

WALLET_NOT_READY.title: Wallet not ready
WALLET_NOT_READY.message: Your YEET wallet isn’t set up for trading yet, so finish sign-in and try again.

CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.title: Quote expired
CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.message: That quote is old. Refresh it and try again.

REQUOTE_REQUIRED.title: Price moved
REQUOTE_REQUIRED.message: The price moved past your minimum, so refresh the quote to see the new numbers.

TRADING_PAUSED.title: Trading is paused
TRADING_PAUSED.message: YEET has paused trading for now and your funds stay in your wallet.

REAUTH_REQUIRED.title: Reconnect YEET
REAUTH_REQUIRED.message: ChatGPT needs your permission again, so reconnect YEET when it asks.

TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE.title: Try again in a minute
TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE.message: YEET could not confirm the result. If you started a trade, check its status before trying again.

USERNAME_TAKEN.title: Username taken
USERNAME_TAKEN.message: That username is taken, so pick another one.

USERNAME_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Username reserved
USERNAME_NOT_ALLOWED.message: That username is reserved, so pick another one.

TERMS_REQUIRED.title: Accept the YEET terms
TERMS_REQUIRED.message: Accept the YEET terms in the chat to continue.

APP_OUTDATED.title: Update YEET
APP_OUTDATED.message: Your YEET in ChatGPT is out of date. Refresh it, then start a new chat.
